name: Long Range
description: Affects a selected target on the field.

name: Adjacent Ally
description: Aaffects an adjacent ally Pokémon. It has no effect in a Single Battle.

name: Self Or Adjacent Ally
description: Can target the user or an adjacent ally.

name: Own Party
description: Affects the user's entire party, including Pokémon that aren't currently on the battlefield, as well as any allies.

name: All Allies (Except Self)
description: Affects all allies simultaneously, except for the user. It has no effect in a Single Battle.

name: One Random
description: Affects one adjacent enemy at random. It targets the enemy Pokémon in Single Battle.

name: All Pokémon
description: Affects all Pokémon on the battlefield at the time the move is used.

name: Entire Field
description: Affects the entire battlefield and all Pokémon on it.

name: Enemy Field
description: Affects the opponent's side of the battlefield.

name: Own Field
description: Affects the user's side of the battlefield.

name: Varies
description: The move is influenced by things such as the opposing Pokémon using a move or the user's type, so the effect and range are not fixed.
